questions.solution:
**Given:**

A boy can swim in still water at a speed of 40 km/hr.

The speed of the current would have been 15 km/hr. 

Let's find the time in which the boy could swim 25 km upstream

**Concept used:**

Upstream speed = Boat speed - speed of the current

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Upstream speed will be 

⇒ 40 - 15 = 25 km

So, the time taken will be 

⇒ 25 / 25 = 1 hr

**∴ The time in which the boy could swim 25 km upstream in 1 hr.**

questions.question: Tina can do a work in 15 days and Manya can do the same work in 18 days. If they worked for 6 days, then what is the fraction of work is left?
questions.solution:
Given:

Tina can do the work in 15 days.

Manya can do the same work in 18 days. 

They worked for 6 days

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 90 units ( Lcm of 18 and 15)

The efficiency of Tina is

⇒ 90 / 15 = 6 unit

Again, the Efficiency of Manya is,

⇒ 90 / 18 = 5 unit

Total Efficiency,

⇒ 6 + 5 = 11 unit

In 6 days total work done,

11 × 6 = 66 unit

Remaining work, 90 - 66 = 24 units

So remaining part,

⇒ 24 / 90

⇒ 4 / 15

**∴ The correct option is 1**

questions.question: A number is divided in the ratio 5 ∶ 7. When 6 was added to each, the ratio changes to 7 ∶ 9. Find the greater number.

A number is divided in the ratio 5 ∶ 7.

When 6 was added to each, the ratio changes to 7 ∶ 9.

Let one number be 5x , so another one is 7x

As per the question,

⇒ (5x + 6) / (7x + 6) = 7 / 9

⇒ 45x + 54 = 49x + 42

⇒ 49x - 45x = 54 - 42

⇒ x = 3

The greater number is 

⇒ 7x = 7 × 3

= 21

**∴ The correct option is 4**

questions.question: Simple interest on a sum for three months at the rate of 15 percent per annum is Rs. 600. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest on a sum for three months at the rate of 15 percent per annum is Rs. 600.

**Calculation:**

Let , principal = P

As per the question:

⇒ 600 = (P × 15 × 3) / (12 × 100)

⇒ P = 600 × (12 × 100) / 15 × 3

⇒ P = 40 × 40× 100

⇒ P = 16000

**∴ The correct option is 1**

questions.question: A girl goes from A to B with speed 60 km/hr and return from B to A with speed 30 km/hr. If whole journey takes 5 hours, then what is the distance between A and B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a person travels a certain distance at speed S₁ and returns at speed S₂ taking total time T, the distance is given by:

Distance = [ (S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂) ] × Total Time

Distance = [ (60 × 30) ÷ (60 + 30) ] × 5

Distance = [ 1800 ÷ 90 ] × 5 = 20 × 5 = 100 km

**∴ The correct answer is 100 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed from A to B (S₁) = 60 km/hr

Speed from B to A (S₂) = 30 km/hr

Total time taken (T) = 5 hours

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db13c818c5460bd7700857e1bfe0a86e1e29c2019966f1744c3f965a2e2612bd.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Let the total distance between A and B be D km.

⇒ Time taken to travel from A to B = D ÷ 60 hours

⇒ Time taken to return from B to A = D ÷ 30 hours

The total time for the whole journey is given as 5 hours.

⇒ (D ÷ 60) + (D ÷ 30) = 5

⇒ (D + 2D) ÷ 60 = 5

⇒ 3D ÷ 60 = 5

⇒ D ÷ 20 = 5

⇒ D = 20 × 5

⇒ D = 100 km

**∴ The correct answer is 100 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

When an object covers two equal distances at speeds S₁ and S₂, the average speed for the entire journey is calculated as (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Average Speed (Equal Time Intervals)

When an object travels at speed S₁ for a certain time and at speed S₂ for an equal amount of time, the average speed is simply the arithmetic mean: (S₁ + S₂) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed

If two bodies are moving in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂). If they are moving in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).

questions.question: Some carpenters promised to complete a work in 20 days. When the work was started, 8 of them were absent and remaining completed the work in 40 days. What was the original number of carpenters?
questions.solution:

Some carpenters promised to complete a work in 20 days.

When the work was started, 8 of them were absent 

Remaining completed the work in 40 days.

**Calculation:**

Let,the original number of carpenters be x

As per the question,

⇒ 20 × x = (x -8) × 40

⇒ 20x = 40x - 320

⇒ x = 16
